summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a share buyback conducted on 20 April 2026 via BNP Paribas SA under an existing buyback programme announced 17 February 2026. It purchased 330,000 ordinary shares at a VWAP of 2,141.19p (approx. $27.23 USD at current GBP/USD rate). The shares will be held as treasury. Since programme start, 20,186,521 shares have been bought; treasury now holds 260,077,615 shares (6.41% of voting rights). No board recommendation or advisor beyond broker named. The buyback is part of a routine open-market return to shareholders under UK rules. Watch for continued execution pace and potential volume impact.
